verses.en: I made a covenant with mine eyes; why then should I think upon a maid?
verses.pt: Fiz pacto com os meus olhos; como, pois, os fixaria numa virgem?
verses.en_web: “I made a covenant with my eyes, how then should I look lustfully at a young woman?
verses.en_bbe: I made an agreement with my eyes; how then might my eyes be looking on a virgin?

verses.en: For what portion of God is there from above? and what inheritance of the Almighty from on high?
verses.pt: Pois que porção teria eu de Deus lá de cima, e que herança do Todo-Poderoso lá do alto?
verses.en_web: For what is the portion from God above, and the heritage from the Almighty on high?
verses.en_bbe: For what is God's reward from on high, or the heritage given by the Ruler of all from heaven?

verses.en: Is not destruction to the wicked? and a strange punishment to the workers of iniquity?
verses.pt: Não é a destruição para o perverso, e o desastre para os obradores da iniqüidade?
verses.en_web: Is it not calamity to the unrighteous, and disaster to the workers of iniquity?
verses.en_bbe: Is it not trouble for the sinner, and destruction for the evil-doers?

verses.en: Doth not he see my ways, and count all my steps?
verses.pt: Não vê ele os meus caminhos, e não conta todos os meus passos?
verses.en_web: Doesn’t he see my ways, and count all my steps?
verses.en_bbe: Does he not see my ways, and are not my steps all numbered?

verses.en: If I have walked with vanity, or if my foot hath hasted to deceit;
verses.pt: Se eu tenho andado com falsidade, e se o meu pé se tem apressado após o engano
verses.en_web: “If I have walked with falsehood, and my foot has hurried to deceit
verses.en_bbe: If I have gone in false ways, or my foot has been quick in working deceit;

verses.en: Let me be weighed in an even balance, that God may know mine integrity.
verses.pt: (pese-me Deus em balanças fiéis, e conheça a minha integridade);
verses.en_web: (let me be weighed in an even balance, that God may know my integrity);
verses.en_bbe: (Let me be measured in upright scales, and let God see my righteousness:)

verses.en: If my step hath turned out of the way, and mine heart walked after mine eyes, and if any blot hath cleaved to mine hands;
verses.pt: se os meus passos se têm desviado do caminho, e se o meu coraçao tem seguido os meus olhos, e se qualquer mancha se tem pegado às minhas mãos;
verses.en_web: if my step has turned out of the way, if my heart walked after my eyes, if any defilement has stuck to my hands,
verses.en_bbe: If my steps have been turned out of the way, or if my heart went after my eyes, or if the property of another is in my hands;

verses.en: Then let me sow, and let another eat; yea, let my offspring be rooted out.
verses.pt: então semeie eu e outro coma, e seja arrancado o produto do meu campo.
verses.en_web: then let me sow, and let another eat. Yes, let the produce of my field be rooted out.
verses.en_bbe: Let me put seed in the earth for another to have the fruit of it, and let my produce be uprooted.

verses.en: If mine heart have been deceived by a woman, or if I have laid wait at my neighbour’s door;
verses.pt: Se o meu coração se deixou seduzir por causa duma mulher, ou se eu tenho armado traição à porta do meu próximo,
verses.en_web: “If my heart has been enticed to a woman, and I have laid wait at my neighbor’s door,
verses.en_bbe: If my heart went after another man's wife, or if I was waiting secretly at my neighbour's door;

verses.en: Then let my wife grind unto another, and let others bow down upon her.
verses.pt: então moa minha mulher para outro, e outros se encurvem sobre ela.
verses.en_web: then let my wife grind for another, and let others sleep with her.
verses.en_bbe: Then let my wife give pleasure to another man and let others make use of her body.

verses.en: For this is an heinous crime; yea, it is an iniquity to be punished by the judges.
verses.pt: Pois isso seria um crime infame; sim, isso seria uma iniqüidade para ser punida pelos juízes;
verses.en_web: For that would be a heinous crime. Yes, it would be an iniquity to be punished by the judges:
verses.en_bbe: For that would be a crime; it would be an act for which punishment would be measured out by the judges:

verses.en: For it is a fire that consumeth to destruction, and would root out all mine increase.
verses.pt: porque seria fogo que consome até Abadom, e desarraigaria toda a minha renda.
verses.en_web: For it is a fire that consumes to destruction, and would root out all my increase.
verses.en_bbe: It would be a fire burning even to destruction, and taking away all my produce.

verses.en: If I did despise the cause of my manservant or of my maidservant, when they contended with me;
verses.pt: Se desprezei o direito do meu servo ou da minha serva, quando eles pleitearam comigo,
verses.en_web: “If I have despised the cause of my male servant or of my female servant, when they contended with me;
verses.en_bbe: If I did wrong in the cause of my man-servant, or my woman-servant, when they went to law with me;

verses.en: What then shall I do when God riseth up? and when he visiteth, what shall I answer him?
verses.pt: então que faria eu quando Deus se levantasse? E quando ele me viesse inquirir, que lhe responderia?
verses.en_web: What then shall I do when God rises up? When he visits, what shall I answer him?
verses.en_bbe: What then will I do when God comes as my judge? and what answer may I give to his questions?

verses.en: Did not he that made me in the womb make him? and did not one fashion us in the womb?
verses.pt: Aquele que me formou no ventre não o fez também a meu servo? E não foi um que nos plasmou na madre?
verses.en_web: Didn’t he who made me in the womb make him? Didn’t one fashion us in the womb?
verses.en_bbe: Did not God make him as well as me? did he not give us life in our mothers' bodies?

verses.en: If I have withheld the poor from their desire, or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail;
verses.pt: Se tenho negado aos pobres o que desejavam, ou feito desfalecer os olhos da viúva,
verses.en_web: “If I have withheld the poor from their desire, or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail,
verses.en_bbe: If I kept back the desire of the poor; if the widow's eye was looking for help to no purpose;

verses.en: Or have eaten my morsel myself alone, and the fatherless hath not eaten thereof;
verses.pt: ou se tenho comido sozinho o meu bocado, e não tem comido dele o órfão também
verses.en_web: or have eaten my morsel alone, and the fatherless has not eaten of it
verses.en_bbe: If I kept my food for myself, and did not give some of it to the child with no father;

verses.en: (For from my youth he was brought up with me, as with a father, and I have guided her from my mother’s womb;)
verses.pt: (pois desde a minha mocidade o órfão cresceu comigo como com seu pai, e a viúva, tenho-a guiado desde o ventre de minha mãe);
verses.en_web: (no, from my youth he grew up with me as with a father, her I have guided from my mother’s womb);
verses.en_bbe: (For I was cared for by God as by a father from my earliest days; he was my guide from the body of my mother;)

verses.en: If I have seen any perish for want of clothing, or any poor without covering;
verses.pt: se tenho visto alguém perecer por falta de roupa, ou o necessitado não ter com que se cobrir;
verses.en_web: if I have seen any perish for want of clothing, or that the needy had no covering;
verses.en_bbe: If I saw one near to death for need of clothing, and that the poor had nothing covering him;

verses.en: If his loins have not blessed me, and if he were not warmed with the fleece of my sheep;
verses.pt: se os seus lombos não me abençoaram, se ele não se aquentava com os velos dos meus cordeiros;
verses.en_web: if his heart hasn’t blessed me, if he hasn’t been warmed with my sheep’s fleece;
verses.en_bbe: If his back did not give me a blessing, and the wool of my sheep did not make him warm;

verses.en: If I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, when I saw my help in the gate:
verses.pt: se levantei a minha mão contra o órfao, porque na porta via a minha ajuda;
verses.en_web: if I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, because I saw my help in the gate,
verses.en_bbe: If my hand had been lifted up against him who had done no wrong, when I saw that I was supported by the judges;

verses.en: Then let mine arm fall from my shoulder blade, and mine arm be broken from the bone.
verses.pt: então caia do ombro a minha espádua, e separe-se o meu braço da sua juntura.
verses.en_web: then let my shoulder fall from the shoulder blade, and my arm be broken from the bone.
verses.en_bbe: May my arm be pulled from my body, and be broken from its base.

verses.en: For destruction from God was a terror to me, and by reason of his highness I could not endure.
verses.pt: Pois a calamidade vinda de Deus seria para mim um horror, e eu não poderia suportar a sua majestade.
verses.en_web: For calamity from God is a terror to me. Because his majesty, I can do nothing.
verses.en_bbe: For the fear of God kept me back, and because of his power I might not do such things.

verses.en: If I have made gold my hope, or have said to the fine gold, Thou art my confidence;
verses.pt: Se do ouro fiz a minha esperança, ou disse ao ouro fino: Tu és a minha confiança;
verses.en_web: “If I have made gold my hope, and have said to the fine gold, ‘You are my confidence;’
verses.en_bbe: If I made gold my hope, or if I ever said to the best gold, I have put my faith in you;

verses.en: If I rejoiced because my wealth was great, and because mine hand had gotten much;
verses.pt: se me regozijei por ser grande a minha riqueza, e por ter a minha mão alcança o muito;
verses.en_web: If I have rejoiced because my wealth was great, and because my hand had gotten much;
verses.en_bbe: If I was glad because my wealth was great, and because my hand had got together a great store;

verses.en: If I beheld the sun when it shined, or the moon walking in brightness;
verses.pt: se olhei para o sol, quando resplandecia, ou para a lua, quando ela caminhava em esplendor,
verses.en_web: if I have seen the sun when it shined, or the moon moving in splendor,
verses.en_bbe: If, when I saw the sun shining, and the moon moving on its bright way,

verses.en: And my heart hath been secretly enticed, or my mouth hath kissed my hand:
verses.pt: e o meu coração se deixou enganar em oculto, e a minha boca beijou a minha mão;
verses.en_web: and my heart has been secretly enticed, and my hand threw a kiss from my mouth,
verses.en_bbe: A secret feeling of worship came into my heart, and my hand gave kisses from my mouth;

verses.en: This also were an iniquity to be punished by the judge: for I should have denied the God that is above.
verses.pt: isso também seria uma iniqüidade para ser punida pelos juízes; pois assim teria negado a Deus que está lá em cima.
verses.en_web: this also would be an iniquity to be punished by the judges; for I should have denied the God who is above.
verses.en_bbe: That would have been another sin to be rewarded with punishment by the judges; for I would have been false to God on high.

verses.en: If I rejoiced at the destruction of him that hated me, or lifted up myself when evil found him:
verses.pt: Se me regozijei com a ruína do que me tem ódio, e se exultei quando o mal lhe sobreveio
verses.en_web: “If I have rejoiced at the destruction of him who hated me, or lifted up myself when evil found him
verses.en_bbe: If I was glad at the trouble of my hater, and gave cries of joy when evil overtook him;

verses.en: Neither have I suffered my mouth to sin by wishing a curse to his soul.
verses.pt: (mas eu não deixei pecar a minha boca, pedindo com imprecação a sua morte);
verses.en_web: (yes, I have not allowed my mouth to sin by asking his life with a curse);
verses.en_bbe: (For I did not let my mouth give way to sin, in putting a curse on his life;)

verses.en: If the men of my tabernacle said not, Oh that we had of his flesh! we cannot be satisfied.
verses.pt: se as pessoas da minha tenda não disseram: Quem há que não se tenha saciado com carne provida por ele?
verses.en_web: if the men of my tent have not said, ‘Who can find one who has not been filled with his meat?’
verses.en_bbe: If the men of my tent did not say, Who has not had full measure of his meat?

verses.en: The stranger did not lodge in the street: but I opened my doors to the traveller.
verses.pt: O estrangeiro não passava a noite na rua; mas eu abria as minhas portas ao viandante;
verses.en_web: (the foreigner has not camped in the street, but I have opened my doors to the traveler);
verses.en_bbe: The traveller did not take his night's rest in the street, and my doors were open to anyone on a journey;

verses.en: If I covered my transgressions as Adam, by hiding mine iniquity in my bosom:
verses.pt: se, como Adão, encobri as minhas transgressões, ocultando a minha iniqüidade no meu seio,
verses.en_web: if like Adam I have covered my transgressions, by hiding my iniquity in my heart,
verses.en_bbe: If I kept my evil doings covered, and my sin in the secret of my breast,

verses.en: Did I fear a great multitude, or did the contempt of families terrify me, that I kept silence, and went not out of the door?
verses.pt: porque tinha medo da grande multidão, e o desprezo das famílias me aterrorizava, de modo que me calei, e não saí da porta...
verses.en_web: because I feared the great multitude, and the contempt of families terrified me, so that I kept silence, and didn’t go out of the door—
verses.en_bbe: For fear of the great body of people, or for fear that families might make sport of me, so that I kept quiet, and did not go out of my door;

verses.en: Oh that one would hear me! behold, my desire is, that the Almighty would answer me, and that mine adversary had written a book.
verses.pt: Ah! quem me dera um que me ouvisse! Eis a minha defesa, que me responda o Todo-Poderoso! Oxalá tivesse eu a acusação escrita pelo meu adversário!
verses.en_web: oh that I had one to hear me! Behold, here is my signature! Let the Almighty answer me! Let the accuser write my indictment!
verses.en_bbe: If only God would give ear to me, and the Ruler of all would give me an answer! or if what he has against me had been put in writing!

verses.en: Surely I would take it upon my shoulder, and bind it as a crown to me.
verses.pt: Por certo eu a levaria sobre o ombro, sobre mim a ataria como coroa.
verses.en_web: Surely I would carry it on my shoulder; and I would bind it to me as a crown.
verses.en_bbe: Truly I would take up the book in my hands; it would be to me as a crown;

verses.en: I would declare unto him the number of my steps; as a prince would I go near unto him.
verses.pt: Eu lhe daria conta dos meus passos; como príncipe me chegaria a ele
verses.en_web: I would declare to him the number of my steps. as a prince would I go near to him.
verses.en_bbe: I would make clear the number of my steps, I would put it before him like a prince! The words of Job are ended.

verses.en: If my land cry against me, or that the furrows likewise thereof complain;
verses.pt: Se a minha terra clamar contra mim, e se os seus sulcos juntamente chorarem;
verses.en_web: If my land cries out against me, and its furrows weep together;
verses.en_bbe: If my land has made an outcry against me, or the ploughed earth has been in sorrow;

verses.en: If I have eaten the fruits thereof without money, or have caused the owners thereof to lose their life:
verses.pt: se comi os seus frutos sem dinheiro, ou se fiz que morressem os seus donos;
verses.en_web: if I have eaten its fruits without money, or have caused its owners to lose their life,
verses.en_bbe: If I have taken its produce without payment, causing the death of its owners;

verses.en: Let thistles grow instead of wheat, and cockle instead of barley. The words of Job are ended.
verses.pt: por trigo me produza cardos, e por cevada joio. Acabaram-se as palavras de Jó.
verses.en_web: let briers grow instead of wheat, and stinkweed instead of barley.” The words of Job are ended.
verses.en_bbe: Then in place of grain let thorns come up, and in place of barley evil-smelling plants.
